name: vercel-account
description: Manage Vercel Account through the built-in Codex browser using the account selected for the current project, with optional read-only CLI/helper diagnostics.

interface.longDescription: Use the active browser account for project-specific accounts, teams, projects, memberships, domains, integrations, spend settings, deployments, and recovery. Management changes use visible UI controls; CLI/helper logs and status are optional read-only supplements with independently verified scope. Browser onboarding requires no API tokens.
defaultPrompt: Open Vercel in the built-in Codex browser, select the project team, and inspect its settings.
Inspect my Vercel Account resources without changes.
Plan a Vercel Account operation and show its target and impact.
